entries.title: Kirin
entries.ai_quote: Anthropic just dropped Fable 5.1, so I decided to build a Minecraft mod with it.
entries.security: Codex Security Standard scan 6a9e7d26-c0cd-41a5-a7ba-b5e0de16b836 assessed the exact official v1.0.0 JAR (SHA-256 7a3459f90eede6f6763e26ae949901a7f361cc83aef66b8c5a1e6389f8c6e827) offline. Coverage was complete for the static artifact scope and produced zero reportable findings. Static review observed a marker-gated client QA harness that checks $HOME/kirinmod/AUTOTEST and can send in-game test actions/request screenshots if the file exists. No mod code was installed, launched, executed or built. Minecraft/Fabric runtime behavior and source-to-release correspondence remain unverified; this is not a malware-free certification.
warnings: Security review was static-only. The exact release JAR was assessed, but no Minecraft/Fabric runtime behavior or source-to-release binary correspondence was verified.
The strike can create fire/lava, debris and crater effects that change the affected Minecraft world area; consider a backup or disposable world. No save-impact/runtime test was performed.
The JAR contains a marker-gated client QA harness: if $HOME/kirinmod/AUTOTEST exists, it can automate in-game test actions and request screenshots. The behavior was not runtime-tested.
The creator describes the mod as Naruto-inspired. Franchise/licensing status was not assessed.
No independent successful-use report was verified; the only described test is the creator’s own account.
